# RIP (`rip`)

- **Layer**: Application and control
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [Routing protocols](../../protocols/routing.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`udp`](udp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 520 (0x0208) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | `enum(8)` | `2` (response) |   | RIP command (1 = request, 2 = response). |
| `version` | `uint(8)` | `2` |   | RIP version (1 or 2; RIPng uses 1). |
| `zero` | `uint(16)` | `0` |   |   |
| `entries` | `list<struct>` — rest of the PDU | 1 items |   | Route entries (AFI, route tag, address, mask, next hop, metric). |

### `command`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | `request` |
| 2 (0x02) | `response` |

### `entries`

Each item is a group of the fields below.

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `afi` | `uint(16)` |   |   |   |
| `route_tag` | `uint(16)` |   |   |   |
| `address` | `ipv4` |   |   |   |
| `subnet_mask` | `ipv4` |   |   |   |
| `next_hop` | `ipv4` |   |   |   |
| `metric` | `uint(32)` |   |   |   |

## Constraints

| Level | Rule |
|---|---|
| warning | `version` within 1..2 |
